item.title: BVI Vacation Without Sailing Experience: Best Yacht Charter Options for Beginners
item.description: Picture waking up to the sound of waves against the hull of a catamaran anchored in a secluded cove in the British Virgin Islands (BVI). Walk on deck and soak up the sunshine and the spectacular views this area is famous for. It’s the perfect holiday, and the best part is that no sailing experience is needed. With Dream Yacht Worldwide , you can enjoy a BVI yacht vacation without having to know a jib from a mainsail. We make sailing accessible to all, with three options especially suited for beginners: Easy Crew, Skippered, and Cabin Cruises. Can You Go on a BVI Vacation Without Sailing Experience? Many people assume that exploring the ocean requires a formal captain’s license or a deep understanding of marine navigation. While renting a boat entirely on your own, known as a bareboat charter , requires sailing experience, there are plenty of ways to enjoy the sea without any technical knowledge. With a crewed BVI sailing vacation , you don’t need to stress about managing a vessel. Our team oversees managing the necessary tasks, such as tracking the weather, anchoring in a busy bay, or interpreting complex nautical terms. You’ll have experienced staff managing onboard systems for you while you enjoy the experience. Our modern catamarans are also stable boats, which means a very low risk of motion sickness and a comfortable stay for those new to life on the water. Best BVI Charter Options If You Don’t Know How to Sail Every traveler has a different preference when it comes to privacy, budget, and daily schedules. Dream Yacht Worldwide provides three distinct entry points designed to match your personal style. Best For Privacy Level Meals Budget Skippered Charter Families and friend groups High (Full private yacht) Cook your own meals or dine ashore Mid to High Easy Crewed Charter Milestone trips and relaxation seekers High (Full private yacht) Half or full board cooked by a host Premium Cabin Cruise Couples, solo travelers, and budget travelers Private cabin, shared deck Set meal plan included in the price Affordable BVI Skippered Yacht Charters: Ultimate Freedom and Privacy A skippered charter means you rent an entire yacht for your group and hire a professional captain to sail it. You have total control over your daily schedule, allowing you to choose exactly when to sail and which bays to visit. The captain handles all the physical labor, anchoring, and navigation, while you and your guests enjoy the exclusive use of the boat. A BVI catamaran charter with skipper is ideal for families who want to cook their own meals or try local beachside restaurants every night. BVI Crewed Yacht Charters: The Effortless Private Getaway If you want the ultimate luxury of a private boat combined with the service of an all-inclusive resort, consider an Easy Crewed charter . Along with a professional captain, you get a dedicated onboard host/cook to manage the galley and handle tasks like grocery shopping (provisioning) or cooking meals during your stay. Cabin Cruises: The Budget-Friendly Entry Point to Sailing A Cabin Cruise is a smart choice for those who want to experience the yachting lifestyle without renting an entire boat. You can book an individual, private cabin with its own bathroom on a large, modern catamaran. The journey follows a pre-planned route, and meals are prepared and served by the crew. Think of it as staying at a boutique hotel that drops anchor at a different, beautiful spot every day. Why the BVI Is Ideal for First-Time Yacht Vacations The British Virgin Islands are widely considered the sailing capital of the Caribbean. The unique geography of the region creates a gentle, welcoming environment for anyone new to the water. Line-of-Sight Navigation and Calm Waters One of the biggest comfort factors in the BVI is that you can almost always see the next island on the horizon. Because the islands form a protected channel, the water remains remarkably calm and sheltered from large ocean swells. This visual navigation removes…

item.title: What’s a Cabin Cruise? Everything You Need to Know Before Booking
item.description: Imagine waking up to the sound of water gently lapping against the hull, stepping outside, and diving straight into a clear, turquoise ocean. For a long time, enjoying a holiday like this meant you either needed a lifetime of sailing experience or the budget to rent a whole private vessel with a captain. Now, travelers can book a cabin cruise and experience the magic of a sailing vacation to an exotic destination for the price of a single hotel room. Even better, sailing experience is not required. You simply book your cabin, step aboard, and leave the work to the crew on board the yacht. Before you pack your bags and head for the marina, here is everything you need to know about this effortless way to explore the world. What Is a Cabin Cruise? A cabin cruise, also called a by-the-cabin sailing charter , is a style of travel where you rent a private stateroom or cabin on a yacht. The rest of the vessel is shared with a small group of like-minded travelers, so you have opportunities to socialize in between exploring islands and relaxing in your room. Every cabin charter trip features a carefully planned route, shared communal spaces, delicious meals, and a professional crew to run the ship. It’s an easy way to dip your toes into the yachting lifestyle. What Is a Cabin Charter Like? The entire travel process is designed to be stress-free from the moment you book your cabin cruise vacation to the day you head home. Choosing Your Destination and Dates Your journey begins by selecting where you want to sail and picking the dates that fit your schedule. These trips follow set itineraries, which you can view ahead of time. This way, you can see which ports you’ll visit and plan ahead of time. Arrival and Boarding When you arrive at the marina base, the crew will welcome you aboard and show you to your private stateroom. After a quick safety briefing and an introduction to the yacht, the captain casts off the lines and sets sail. Your Cruise Each day follows a relaxing rhythm of sailing, swimming, exploring hidden coves, and enjoying fresh meals on deck. While the captain handles the sailing, you share the spacious decks with your fellow passengers. Do You Need Sailing Experience? With this type of sailing vacation, no experience is required. You do not need to know how to tie a single knot, read a navigation chart, or handle a steering wheel. The price of your cabin includes the services of the captain and crew. They take care of navigation, weather tracking, anchoring, and all daily shipboard operations. The only thing you need to do the entire week is relax and have fun. What’s Included in a Cabin Yacht Charter? Inclusions vary based on the package you choose and the company you book with. Premium options, such as Dream Yacht ’s cabin cruises, typically include: A private, comfortable double cabin with its own bathroom Access to all shared yacht spaces, like the forward trampolines, salon, and sun decks The full services of a professional captain and cook Onboard water toys, which may include things like snorkeling gear, paddleboards, and kayaks Before booking, be sure to check the trip details to confirm inclusions and what you might need to cover during your cruise. Food, Beverages, and Culinary Options Many packages offer a half-board plan, which includes select meals such as breakfast and lunch. With half-board options, you may dine ashore at ports where you drop anchor. Other packages feature a full-board plan, which means breakfast, lunch, and dinner are included. Optional Excursions and Extras Depending on where you are sailing, you might have the option to add on excursions like guided island hikes and historical tours. It is always a good idea to check your specific package details before booking, so you know exactly what is covered and what extras you might want to explore. item.title: The best of the British Virgin Islands discovered
item.description: If you haven’t cruised the best of the British Virgin Islands , it’s time to put it at the top of your wanderlust list. The secret is out, and this gorgeous chain of islands located just a short ferry-hop from the USVI is more popular than ever. From old salty sailors to the newly indoctrinated, everyone can agree that it’s a cruising paradise – and much more. One thing becomes very clear after you’ve visited the BVI. It’s best discovered by boat, and definitely not aboard a cruise ship that docks on Tortola. There are many unique islands that make up the BVI – 4 larger islands (Tortola, Anegada, Virgin Gorda, and Jost Van Dyke) and over 30 smaller islands, some of which are uninhabited. And to truly see the best of the British Virgin Islands , a yacht charter vacation can not be beat. It’s a freeing and romantic way to experience these stunning islands – from a boat like the merchants and pirates of Robert Louis Stevenson’s famed novel Treasure Island. (perhaps the perfect read for your upcoming sailing vacation!) But don’t be concerned if you aren’t a sailor, because there’s a BVI sailing vacation option for everyone. Dream Yacht Charter offers boats that you sail yourself (bareboat), and also options to hire a skipper to take the helm for you. This is perfect for groups of family and friends vacationing together. If traveling alone or with a partner, you can choose to take a cabin aboard a large comfortable sailing catamaran where most everything is included and pre-planned – so all you need to do is relax and enjoy! So go ahead – sail, sun, dine and snorkel your way through the best of the British Virgin Islands. You will not find a more exciting way for a group of friends to travel together, see the world in a new way and reconnect. Read on to learn more! Play among the boulders of the Baths, Virgin Gorda The Baths on Virgin Gorda are a must-do for any best of the British Virgin Islands adventure. Arrive early, grab a national parks mooring ball, and swim in, or take a dinghy to the tether line located off the main beach. Don’t dinghy to shore here, it’s not permitted due to rough surf and swimmers in the water. Take your time to meander and climb your way through the enormous partially submerged boulders scattered along the shoreline creating an otherworldly playground of caverns and beautiful hidden pools. Bring your camera along in a dry bag or you’ll certainly regret the missed Instagram-worthy photo opps. When you need a rest from climbing, jumping and swimming, sample the cocktails and spectacular views at Top of the Baths restaurant and bar. Newly reopened yacht club & resort favorites A couple of the most beloved yachtie haunts have reopened and are eager to welcome new and returning cruisers alike. Sailors everywhere were crushed to learn of the shocking devastation to the Bitter End Yacht Club and Saba Rock following Hurricane Irma in 2017, and it’s wonderful to see them reopening. The Bitter End Yacht Club has been very busy indeed, opening the Quarterdeck Marina, Reef Sampler Beach Bar, Buoy Room restaurant, gourmet market, and a watersports center! Choose to grab a mooring ball in the mooring field, or for a real treat stay on the dock for the evening and enjoy all they have on offer while supporting the return of this iconic property. Stroll the beautiful grounds and take notice of the finer details, where care has been taken to integrate pieces, parts and concepts from BEYC’s past, helping to carry on the legacy. One notable detail is the hull of the vessel Reef Sampler sitting prominently near the beach. At the heart of Bitter End operations from its founding, she was raised from the depths of the North Sound seabed, and most fittingly fashioned into the Reef Sampler Beach Bar – now buzzing with activity. Be sure to top off your yacht’s provisions at the beautifully outfitted gourmet market and pick up your souvenirs from the Reef Boutique, stocked with gorgeous, perfectly-curated and as always, irresistib…

item.title: How to charter a yacht for vacation
item.description: If you’re wondering how to charter a yacht for vacation, or want to know about the different types of charters, then you’ve come to the right place. A sailing vacation provides plenty of time to explore new islands, relax on beautiful beaches and snorkel in tropical seas while spending quality time with your family and friends. Combining adventure with relaxation, it’s a great way to spend your much-needed vacation. Sound interesting? Discover how you can charter a yacht for vacation with us. 1. Decide where you want to charter We have the widest choice of destinations, in fact we have more than 60 exquisite locations where you can hire a yacht for a vacation, including the Caribbean, Bahamas, Indian Ocean, Pacific, Asia and the Mediterranean to name a few. We choose our bases carefully. Close to airports : Our bases are close to major international hubs and our friendly and welcoming base teams can organize transfers for you Local knowledge : Each destination on our website has useful information to help you prepare, including a guide to the local base and area Discover our exciting destinations . 2. Decide which yacht charter type is right for you If you are wondering how to charter a yacht, you also need to decide which charter type is right for you. We offer bareboat yacht charters, skippered charters, by the cabin charters and crewed yacht charters. Bareboat yacht charters for sailors : If you have sailing experience, you can hire a yacht and sail yourself with our bareboat yacht charters. You can even sail one way from some locations. Unsure if you have the right sailing qualifications? Read our guide, are you qualified for a bareboat yacht charter ? Explore our bareboat yacht charter fleet . Skippered charters for vacations with a difference : If you want to experience a sailing vacation and can’t sail, it’s likely you’re questioning how to rent a yacht. All you need to do is hire a skipper to sail the boat for you with our skippered yacht charters. No sailing experience is needed. The skipper will sail your yacht, look after your safety, track the weather and advise you on your route. Learn more about our skippered charters . By the cabin charters for hassle-free, exciting vacations : Reserve a stateroom with private bathroom and explore 15+ wonderful destinations worldwide with our hassle-free, organized cruises. All you need to do is book your flights, arrive and relax. Our experienced captain will sail the boat while a professional chef will prepare all your meals for you. Discover our by the cabin charters and read our FAQs . Crewed charters for the ultimate customized experience : If you’re looking for a nearly all-inclusive sailing vacation, our crewed charters offer premium service from a professional crew on board our private yachts. Relax with your guests and enjoy a completely personalized experience tailored to your preferences. You don’t need sailing experience, just an idea of your dream vacation. Experience our crewed charters and read our FAQs . Sabbatical yacht charters for adventure seekers : For those searching for an adventure of a lifetime, our sabbatical yacht charters are designed for bluewater sailing enthusiasts wanting to explore the world. Our sabbatical fleet is kitted out for voyages up to 12-months. Our long-term charter service includes training, support during your voyage and maintenance at our bases worldwide. Find out more about sabbatical yacht charters and read our FAQs . 3. Find your dream yacht When looking for your dream yacht, the following points in our how to charter a yacht guide are important to consider. Our boats are priced according to their age, features, destination and season you are sailing. For advice on how to keep your charter affordable, read our guide on how much bareboat yacht charters cost under the FAQs tab . Short on time? We can find your dream yacht for you. Contact our team .
